---
title: "From Days to Minutes: A Just-in-Time Pipeline for Plot-Level Supply-Chain Analytics"
author: "Jake Wilkins"
resources:
  - images/epoch-logo-white.png
format:
  revealjs:
    theme:
      - default
      - custom.scss
      - styles/s01.scss
      - styles/s02.scss
      - styles/s03.scss
      - styles/s04.scss
      - styles/s05.scss
      - styles/s06.scss
      - styles/s07.scss
      - styles/s08.scss
      - styles/s09.scss
      - styles/s10.scss
      - styles/s11.scss
      - styles/s12.scss
      - styles/s13.scss
      - styles/s14.scss
      - styles/s15.scss
      - styles/s16.scss
      - styles/s17.scss
      - styles/s18.scss
      - styles/s19.scss
      - styles/s20.scss
      - styles/s21.scss
      - styles/s22.scss
      - styles/s23.scss
      - styles/s24.scss
    auto-slide: 15000
    auto-slide-stoppable: false
    slide-number: false
    progress: true
    navigation-mode: linear
    controls: false
    hash: true
    logo: images/cng-logo-ink.svg
    width: 1600
    height: 900
    chalkboard: false
    include-after-body:
      - animations.html
      - text: |
          <script>
            // Epoch logo on the title slide (Quarto has no title-slide image option)
            // The template renames #title-slide at runtime, so match the class.
            document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
              const t = document.querySelector('.reveal .slides > section.quarto-title-block');
              if (!t || t.querySelector('img.epoch-logo-title')) return;
              // Keep hyphenated words (Just-in-Time, Plot-Level) on one line
              const h = t.querySelector('h1.title');
              if (h) h.textContent = h.textContent.replace(/-/g, '\u2011');
              const img = document.createElement('img');
              img.src = 'images/epoch-logo-white.png';
              img.alt = 'Epoch';
              img.className = 'epoch-logo-title';
              t.appendChild(img);
            });
          </script>
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
        <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
        <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Google+Sans:wght@400;500;700&family=Space+Grotesk:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
title-slide-attributes:
  data-background-image: images/epoch-title-bg.jpg
  data-background-size: cover
  data-autoslide: "0"
  data-state: no-bars
---
